scope: Engineering review targets for PCB copper only, not current-rating or thermal qualification. Limits may be revised with explicit reasoning before evaluation.

material_assumptions.note: Nominal assumptions only. Actual finished copper/plating/stackup must be confirmed by fabricator. 85C is an arithmetic copper-resistance sensitivity case, not approved battery operating temperature.

short_neck_policy: Small pin escapes can be narrower than trunk target. Flag when cumulative sub-target track length on the chosen path exceeds the per-path allowance. Do not count only individual segment lengths, which would hide a long narrow route split into many pieces.
mandatory_structural_review: Preserve complete local inductor/decoupling/feedback routes and ground-via access.
TPS63802 feedback must branch from C202 positive before R203, not downstream 3V3_AON.
Battery charging/discharging trunk must not flow through MAX17048/C204 quiet sense branch.
Preserve both NTC inputs/reference filters and comparator feedback wiring, with low-noise ground return.
BQ exposed pad and VSS8 both connect GND; TPS63802 AGND3 and PGND8 both connect GND.
No non-GND signals on the dedicated In1/In2 ground planes; verify plane continuity and via backdrill/filled-hole requirements separately.
limitations: Copper path calculations exclude ICs, 0ohm links, connectors, protection FETs, solder, pad spreading and GND return resistance.

A minimum-resistance connected path is calculated from native connectivity. Full segment lengths are charged even when touching mid-segment; parallel paths are not combined. This is an inspectable path estimate, not a circuit/field solver.
No IPC current rating, temperature rise, impedance or transient voltage claim follows from this review.
Existing battery-current and charge-enable restrictions remain unchanged.
